title: Takeout Style Fried Rice
cScaleSummary: Two large eggs contribute approximately 372 mg cholesterol to the batch, or 93 mg per serving at four servings. The other ingredients are plant-derived. This places the recipe in C3, the 76-150 mg range.
ldlActiveSummary: Does not meet the EWHF LDL-Active criteria because white rice remains the dominant ingredient. Peas, onion, water chestnuts, and unsaturated oil add variety, but the dish is not centered on whole grains or legumes.
intro: Fried rice turns cooked rice into a dish with a texture of its own: loose grains, lightly toasted edges, and small bites of vegetables and egg. This takeout-style version is meant to sit beside a saucy main course, so the seasoning stays restrained. White pepper gives it a familiar warmth, ginger adds a sharper note, and water chestnuts keep a clean crunch. Cook the eggs separately so they remain distinct, then fold them in at the end. Cold rice and a hot, uncrowded pan make the difference.
miseEnPlace: Break apart {{ingredient:cooked-rice}} with your fingers or a fork.
Measure {{ingredient:egg-oil}}, {{ingredient:rice-oil}}, {{ingredient:soy-sauce}}, {{ingredient:white-pepper}}, and {{ingredient:sesame-oil}} before heating the pan.

stepGroups.title: Scramble the Eggs
items: Heat a wok or large skillet over medium heat. Add {{ingredient:egg-oil}}, then {{ingredient:eggs}}. Stir gently until the eggs form small curds and are fully set. Transfer to a clean plate.

stepGroups.title: Cook the Aromatics
items: Raise the heat to high and add {{ingredient:rice-oil}}. Add the prepared {{ingredient:yellow-onion}} and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until the edges begin to soften and color. Add the prepared {{ingredient:ginger}} and {{ingredient:water-chestnuts}}. Stir-fry for about 30 seconds.

stepGroups.title: Fry the Rice
items: Add the prepared {{ingredient:cooked-rice}}. Spread it across the hot pan and leave undisturbed for about 30 seconds. Toss and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, breaking up clumps and letting some grains toast. Add the prepared {{ingredient:peas}} and stir-fry for about 30 seconds. Cook larger yields in batches so the rice fries rather than steams.

stepGroups.title: Season and Finish
items: Pour {{ingredient:soy-sauce}} around the hot sides of the pan. Add {{ingredient:white-pepper}} and stir until the rice is evenly seasoned and piping hot. Fold in the cooked scrambled eggs. Turn off the heat, add {{ingredient:sesame-oil}}, and toss once more. Serve immediately alongside Chinese Chicken and Broccoli. Keep the rice fairly dry so it can take up the sauce at the table.
